INSERT INTO system_audit_log ( sales_user_id, action_type_code, ip_address, user_agent, reason ) VALUES ( #{salesUserId}, #{actionTypeCode}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{reason} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, branch_id, employee_id, password_hash, name, birth_date, email, phone, rank_code, role_code, status_code, is_temp_password, terms_agreed FROM sales_user WHERE id = #{userId}
